Central.reason: Central Line: Severe delays due to an earlier trespasser on the track at Leyton. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, Liberty Line, Elizabeth Line, Chiltern Railways, Great Western Railway and Greater Anglia via any reasonable route.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No Service between Chalfont & Latimer and Chesham while we deal with a trespasser on the track at Chesham. MINOR DELAYS between Moor Park and Watford due to train cancellations. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: Minor delays between Acton Town and Uxbridge due to an earlier signal failure at Osterley. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

Weaver.reason: Weaver Line: Until Thursday 16th July, there will be no service between Walthamstow Central and Chingford while we conduct urgent repairs to the track following a line side fire near Wood Street. Please use London Underground and London Buses to complete your journey. SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line.
